name: Paludal-Antiphon
description: A killed landscape, vacuum-scoured and silent. The regolith holds bootprints beautifully; there are some near glass plains from an ancient cataclysm that no expedition has ever claimed.
With no air to speak of, silence is total, broken only by whatever touches your boots. The horizon stays razor-sharp at any distance.
Core samples from the deep crust contain isotopes with no known decay chain. The samples are stored off-world now, and studied reluctantly.
Opportunity here wears armor. Claims on platinum, silicon and salvageable alloys are staked, defended, and occasionally avenged, and the nearest law is a week's burn away.
